trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं hospital से call कर रहा हूँ। क्या मेरी बात उनसे हो रही है जिनका patient ID PT-1009 है?
हाँ, मैं ही बोल रहा हूँ। क्या हुआ, कोई problem है क्या?
नहीं, कोई problem नहीं है। आपकी identity verify करने के लिए, क्या आप अपना date of birth बता सकते हैं?
मेरा date of birth 12 May 1980 है। ये verification क्यों करना पड़ता है?
आपकी जानकारी सुरक्षित रखने के लिए ये ज़रूरी है। क्या आप अपना registered pincode भी बता सकते हैं?
अच्छा, ठीक है। मेरा pincode 110001 है। अब बताइए क्या बात है?
धन्यवाद। आपकी details match हो गयी हैं। मैं आपको याद दिलाने के लिए call कर रहा था कि कल आपका cardiology department में appointment है।
Cardiology... मतलब दिल वाले doctor के पास ना? मेरा chest pain थोड़ा बढ़ गया है। क्या मैं अभी कोई painkiller ले सकता हूँ?
जी हाँ, दिल के doctor। माफ़ कीजिएगा, मैं कोई दवाई या medical advice नहीं दे सकता। मैं सिर्फ आपका appointment manage कर सकता हूँ। क्या आप कल doctor से मिलने आएँगे?
ठीक है, समझ गया। लेकिन कल सुबह मुझे काम है। क्या कल दोपहर का time मिल सकता है? सुबह का time cancel करना पड़ेगा।
कल दोपहर 2 बजे Dr. Sharma के पास एक slot available है। इसकी fee 500 rupees है। क्या मैं ये book कर दूँ?
हाँ, दोपहर 2 बजे ठीक रहेगा। और fee 500 rupees है ना? एक बार confirm कर लीजिए।
steps.clean_text: हाँ, दोपहर 2 बजे ठीक रहेगा। और fee 500 rupees है ना? एक बार confirm कर लीजिए।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, दोपहर 2 बजे ठीक रहेगा। और free 500 rupees है ना? एक बार confirm कर लीजिए।

steps.text: जी हाँ, fee बिल्कुल 500 rupees ही है। मैं आपका appointment book कर रहा हूँ, बस एक minute line पर रहिए।
आपका दोपहर 2 बजे का appointment confirm हो गया है। आपका booking reference number BKG-992 है।
Reference number BKG-992 है। ठीक है, मैं लिख लेता हूँ। मुझे कोई message आएगा क्या इसका?
मैं message आने की guarantee नहीं दे सकता, इसलिए आप ये reference number BKG-992 अपने पास ज़रूर लिख कर रखें। क्या मैं आपकी और कोई मदद कर सकता हूँ?
नहीं, बस यही पता करना था। धन्यवाद।

variant_findings.reason: The user asks for clinical advice (whether they can take a painkiller), and the agent correctly identifies this as out of scope, declining to provide medical advice without hallucinating a policy or capability.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Out-of-context identification and escalation > Out-of-Scope Request Identification

variant_findings.reason: The agent strictly grounds its responses in the tool outputs (quoting the exact fee of 500 and the booking reference BKG-992) and refuses to provide an unsupported forward guarantee about receiving an SMS confirmation.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The caller reports that their chest pain has increased ('मेरा chest pain थोड़ा बढ़ गया है'). For a cardiology patient, this is a symptom suggesting a medical emergency. According to the escalation conditions, the agent must escalate the call. Instead, the agent treats it as a routine request for medical advice and continues to book the appointment.
issues.repair_instruction: Change the user's symptom in e10 to something minor and non-emergency (e.g., a mild headache or knee pain) so that the agent's refusal to give medical advice in e11 is appropriate and does not violate the emergency escalation condition.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the target variants, including out-of-scope identification and strict tool grounding. However, the user's choice of symptom (increased chest pain) inadvertently triggers the emergency escalation condition, which the agent ignores. A surface repair to the symptom will make the scenario safe and policy-compliant.
